title: The parts import adds a Part Library entry for a new part number
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Use a new part number that no Part Library entry has yet.
  • Have a parts import file with one row for the new part number, with a description, a category, a cost of 10.00 and a quantity of 2, so the import adds a part.
  • Start on the Inventory data import page (Settings, then Data Import, then Inventory).
custom_steps:
1. Upload the file.
  2. Run the import.
  3. Click Parts in the top bar.
  4. Click Part Library in the left menu.
  5. Type the new part number in the Search box.
  6. Click the new entry's row.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The file is ready to import.

Step 2:

  • The import finishes with no error for the row.

Step 3:

  • The Parts left menu shows Part Library.

Step 4:

  • The Part Library page opens.

Step 5:

  • Exactly one entry is listed for the new part number: the parts import made it from the imported row.

Step 6:

  • Its detail page shows "Total parts" 1, with one Workplace row for the test location: the imported part is behind it.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Parts Lifecycle Update", Confluence 829227015, version 33 (23 Oct 2026, owner Chris Ward), read 27 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10647, story SV-10824 (Story 11, The Part Library Is Browse and Edit Only)

  • S11-R6: “A new Part Library entry is created only from a part number in use: creating an inventory part (S7-R7 and S7-R8), a part request when the requested part is received, a delivery receipt, a core charge, returning a special-order part to inventory, returning a core to inventory, the parts CSV import, and the public API.”
  • S11-N1: “No route, on screen or behind it, produces a Part Library entry with no inventory part, part request, delivery receipt, core charge, return or import row behind it. The one exception is the public API (S11-E3).”
